Bzip2 format ported from dsnet/compress semantics.

Own block pipeline: RLE1, BWT (prefix-doubling suffix array with radix sort), MTF+RLE2, canonical Huffman (two-queue + length limiting, max 20 bits), unary selectors with MTF. CRC-32/BZIP2 (MSB-first, poly 0x04C11DB7) per block plus the combined stream checksum. Randomized blocks are rejected like the reference does. Works on Input/Output: no stream objects, no per-call output allocation when the caller reuses an Output.
